Agent._comment_secrets: TenantId, AgentCode and AgentKey are secrets/environment-specific - do NOT commit real values here. Use appsettings.Production.json (git-ignored), the ASP.NET Core User Secrets tool for local dev, or environment variables (Agent__AgentKey=..., Agent__TenantId=..., etc. - the .NET Configuration provider maps double-underscore env vars onto this section automatically) when installing at a client site.
Agent._comment_agent: AgentCode/AgentKey must match a BiometricAgent record created from the ERP MVC (Biometric Agents > Add Agent). The key is shown once at creation time - copy it here immediately.
Agent._comment_device: Device is ONLY used for local testing without the API (e.g. running the Mock driver standalone with `dotnet run`). Remove this section entirely for a real deployment - devices are fetched from GET /api/BiometricAgent/devices based on what the admin assigned to this AgentCode in the ERP.
